output.patientMessage: I recommend self-care for now: your right-hand numbness and tingling worse at night fits a common nerve-compression pattern in the wrist. Avoid sleeping with wrists bent and note which fingers are affected. If you develop new weakness or clumsiness in the hand, constant loss of feeling, or the symptoms keep progressing, arrange a clinician assessment. If you get sudden face drooping, arm weakness or trouble speaking, call 911 immediately.
